items.title: 69537_Jimmy Jones oral history interview
items.q: Marj Morrow and I, we came up together

ctx.x: You know, because it keeps me going. I can get a rapport with them or something, you know. So Marj Morrow and I, we came up together, and he went to John Marshall Law School, and I went to Kentucky State University, and I got involved with sociology, you know?
How did you happen to decide to major in sociology?
